# Cerilas' Tools & GrowthControl

> Cerilas' Tools (https://tools.cerilas.com) is a collection of free web utilities for marketers, developers and creators, plus GrowthControl, an AI visibility tracker and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform. Most file tools (image, PDF and video compression, PDF editing, background removal) run locally in the browser. Built by Cerilas (CERİLAS Yüksek Teknoloji San. ve Tic. AŞ). Content is in English and aimed at the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia.

## GrowthControl: AI visibility tracker & GEO platform

- [GrowthControl](https://tools.cerilas.com/growth): AI visibility tracking software. It runs the questions buyers ask in ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity and Claude, records whether a brand is mentioned or its website is cited as a source, and shows which competitors appear instead.
- Key features: AI citation and brand mention tracking, competitor AI share of voice, read-only Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 integration, AI crawler access audit (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), llms.txt and Schema.org checks, Google Business Profile review radar, and a weekly prioritized action feed with ready-to-paste fixes.
- Target markets: per-prompt country and language targeting for the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia (other countries are also supported).
- Pricing (USD): Forever Free, $0 (1 workspace, 3 tracked prompts). Pro, $9.99/month or $99.90/year (3 workspaces, 15 tracked prompts, 3 competitors). Unlimited, $14.99/month or $149.90/year (unlimited workspaces and competitors, 30 tracked prompts).
- Best for: SaaS and B2B software companies, marketing and SEO agencies managing multiple clients, e-commerce and DTC brands, and local service businesses.

## AI Visibility Checker (free)

- [AI Visibility Checker](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/ai-visibility-checker): Free, no-signup AI visibility checker. Enter a website URL and target country; the tool generates 10 realistic buyer questions from the site's content, asks AI search, and reports for each question whether the site is cited, only mentioned, or not visible. Returns an AI visibility score (A+ to F), the competing sources cited instead, and recommended fixes. Fair-use limit of a few checks per hour.
- Checker vs. tracker: the checker is a one-time snapshot; GrowthControl re-runs the same prompts on a schedule, tracks competitors and stores history.

## Key definitions

- AI visibility: how often AI assistants mention a brand, cite its website as a source, or recommend competitors, across the questions customers ask.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): making a brand easy for AI answer engines to understand, trust and cite, through answer-first content, structured data, open AI crawler access, llms.txt and third-party mentions.
- Citation rate: share of tracked prompts where the AI links to the brand's own domain.
- AI share of voice: how often a brand appears compared with tracked competitors across the same prompts.

## AI search & GEO tools

- [AI Crawler Checker](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/ai-crawler-checker): Audit robots.txt directives and HTTP access rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended).
- [LLMs.txt Generator & Validator](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/llms-txt): Build, parse and validate /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt files.
- [AI Link Hallucination Checker](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/ai-link-hallucination-checker): Scan LLM outputs for fabricated links, broken citations and 404s with live HTTP validation.
- [Connect ChatGPT to Google Analytics & Search Console (MCP Server)](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/google-marketing-mcp): Connect Google Analytics 4, Search Console and Google Ads to ChatGPT, Claude Desktop and Cursor via the Model Context Protocol with read-only OAuth.
- [Universal Token Counter](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/token-counter-universal): Count tokens and estimate cost across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek and Llama models.
- [AI Content Detector](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/ai-content-detector): Estimate the probability that text or a PDF was AI-generated, with perplexity and burstiness metrics.
- [PDF → RAG Cleaner](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/pdf-rag-cleaner): Turn PDFs into clean Markdown, JSON chunks and metadata for LangChain, LlamaIndex and vector databases.

## File, media & productivity tools

- [PDF Editor](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/pdf-editor): Edit PDFs in the browser: add text, sign, redact, rotate and reorder pages, without watermarks.
- [PDF Compressor](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/pdf-compressor): Compress PDFs with Extreme, Recommended and High Quality presets, locally in the browser.
- [Image Compressor](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/image-compressor): Batch compress JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and SVG files in the browser with a comparison slider and ZIP download.
- [Video Compressor](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/video-compressor): Compress MP4, WebM and MOV locally with quality presets, trimming and audio muting.
- [Background Remover](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/background-remover): Remove image backgrounds in the browser with an on-device model; exports transparent PNG.
- [QR Code Generator](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/qr-code-generator): Static QR codes that never expire, exported as SVG or high-resolution PNG, for URLs, Wi-Fi, vCard, text and email.
- [Email Signature Generator](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/email-signature-generator): HTML email signatures for Gmail, Apple Mail and Outlook.
- [ATS Resume Checker](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/ats-resume-checker): Test resume readability for applicant tracking systems and keyword match against a job description.
- [Webhook Tester](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/webhook-tester): Inspect and debug incoming webhooks with unique live URLs.
- [JSON Beautifier & Formatter](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/json-beautifier): Format, validate, minify and repair JSON with a tree viewer.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/youtube-thumbnail-downloader): Download HD thumbnails from any YouTube video or Shorts URL.
- [Task Prioritization & Capacity Planner](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/task-prioritization-planner): Free in-browser planner. Scores tasks 0–100 with weighted criteria (impact, strategic alignment, urgency, deadline risk, effort, custom), calculates total available hours, usable capacity (after a buffer) and utilization for any date range from per-weekday hours, breaks, holidays and date overrides, then auto-schedules tasks around deadlines, dependencies and locked calendar blocks. Daily, weekly, monthly and timeline views; downloadable PDF plan report (capacity KPIs, priority ranking, day-by-day schedule, feasibility check); exports .ics, CSV and JSON. Formulas: Usable Capacity = Total Available Hours × (1 − Buffer % / 100); Utilization = Scheduled Task Hours / Usable Capacity × 100.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/pomodoro-timer): Minimal in-browser Pomodoro timer with customizable intervals.
- [EU Funding & Cascade Grants](https://tools.cerilas.com/tool/eu-funding-opportunities): Searchable database of Horizon Europe calls and cascade funding (FSTP) sub-grants.
